_comment: Skills this repository develops against. They are NOT committed: .claude/* is
gitignored here and this repository is public, so vendoring 3.5 MB of a
third-party skill into it is a cost nobody asked for. This file records what to
fetch and what it hashed to, so a teammate ends up with the same thing.

emil-design-eng.why: Motion decisions. Easing curves, durations, interruptibility, @starting-style, never animating from scale(0). The reference behind the motion tokens and the celebration layer (DESIGN.md).

impeccable.why: Design review and refinement playbooks (bolder, delight, animate, colorize, critique). Its `init` writes a PRODUCT.md and installs a detector hook; neither has been run here, deliberately — that is tooling, and DESIGN.md is already this project's brief.
